name: corvio-workspace
description: Help your Agent ground research, reports, plans, project work, document edits, and reusable deliverables in an authorized Corvio Workspace through OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Search prior work first; preserve reusable results.
interface.longDescription: Use Corvio alongside the host's normal workflow for attached-file organization, research, reports, comparisons, proposals, plans, decisions, meeting notes, project work, debugging, reviews, and follow-ups. Retrieve authorized context, preserve original files and reusable results, and keep selected local-file access explicit.
defaultPrompt: For any research, reporting, planning, decision, meeting-note, project, debugging, document-editing, or substantive-deliverable work, begin with one relevant Corvio read even without prior material; continue normally if there is no match.
Retain user-provided files that should stay useful and organize coherent sets into a maintainable Work Model before treating a derived summary as complete.
Treat a substantive authorized deliverable as worth saving unless the user makes it transient or local-only; read back the durable result and return its canonical link.
Preview selected local agent work before importing it; do not capture unrelated private work.
